hypothesis: H-MEMEXS: weekly cross-sectional selection restricted to MEMECOIN perps on Binance USDT-M, market-neutral within memes
parent: H-AGEDXS (sources/leads/documented_edges_round12.md idea 4); H-MOMENTUM (reports/candidates/momentum.md: broad-perp XS_L7_LO passed validation, failed holdout; long-short XS failed). Scope: reports/scope_memecoins_20261005.md
rationale: Broad-perp momentum's long-only survivor was market beta + funding on squeezed coins; long-short failed. Memes are the user's scope and a more homogeneous, retail/attention-driven cross-section where 1-4w momentum or reversal, crowding (funding) and attention (volume growth) effects may differ. Testing within-meme neutral spreads removes meme-sector beta (the failure mode of XS_L7_LO).
frozen_before: any meme-perp return, signal value or P&L was computed by this agent. Only identity classification (no prices) and per-week counts of liquidity-eligible memes (quote volume only, to set the min-universe rule) were looked at.

universe_classification.source: CoinGecko 'meme-token' category (/coins/markets?category=meme-token), cached at data/raw/web/coingecko/listshort_meme_category.json, fetched 2026-10-05 for H-LISTSHORT; rule + identity overrides exactly as scripts/research/listshort_classify.py (symbol match after stripping 1000/1000000/1M prefixes; on symbol collisions the meme coin must be the largest-cap CoinGecko coin with that symbol; documented REMOVE/ADD identity corrections).
universe_classification.look_ahead_risk: This is TODAY's (2026-10-05) category list applied to history. Coins that were memes but died and left CoinGecko (or were never categorised) are missing; coins that became famous are in. Mitigation: every Binance USDT-M perp that ever existed in the data.binance.vision archive for a classified coin is included, delisted ones too (delisted while held -> exit at last close, 2% penalty). Residual survivorship toward still-listed CoinGecko coins remains and is stated in the report.
universe_classification.applied_to: data/raw/web/momentum/symbols.json (900 archive USDT-M symbols incl. delisted, listed 2026-10-05); klines exist through 2026-03 for those listed before 2026-04.

data: Read-only reuse of data/raw/web/momentum/{klines,funding} (data.binance.vision futures/um monthly 1d klines and fundingRate, months <= 2026-03). Nothing from 2026-04 onward is read. Holdout cache data/raw/web/momentum/holdout is never opened.
eligibility: Point in time at each rebalance t (Monday 00:00 UTC): >= 35 daily bars closed before t, a bar for day t-1, >= 25 of the last 30 days present, 30-day mean daily quote volume (days t-30..t-1) >= $5M. A week is traded only if >= 8 memes are eligible; otherwise the week is flat and excluded from Sharpe and week counts (number of skipped weeks reported).

signals.R7: close(t-1)/close(t-8)-1 (daily close of day d = price at 00:00 d+1)
signals.FUND7: sum of Binance funding prints with calc_time in [t-7d, t) (strictly before t); low = long
signals.VOLG: quote volume sum days t-7..t-1 divided by (quote volume sum days t-35..t-8)/4; high = long
signals.direction: mom: long highest signal; rev: long lowest; low_long: long lowest; high_long: long highest

portfolio.LS: long top-k at +0.5/k each, short bottom-k at -0.5/k each (dollar-neutral, gross 1)
portfolio.BASKET: long top-k at +0.5/k each, short equal-weight basket of all n eligible memes at -0.5/n each; net per-coin weights traded (gross <= 1)

execution: weights set at t, filled at close(t-1) (= open t) with costs, held to t+7 at constant notional (positions truncated at split end and force-closed there). No intra-week rebalancing or stops.

costs.taker: 5 bp per side (Binance USDT-M VIP0 taker 0.05%)
costs.slippage: per side by 30d mean daily quote volume: >= $1B 2 bp; $200M-1B 5 bp; $50M-200M 10 bp; < $50M 20 bp (same tiers as H-MOMENTUM; assumption)
costs.turnover: cost = |w_new - w_old| * (taker + slippage), charged to the coin-week leg being entered/resized, or to the leg being closed on exit
costs.funding: w * rate for every fundingRate print with calc_time in (t, t+7d] while held (long pays positive)
costs.delisting: data ends while held -> exit at last close, 2% of |w| penalty
costs.lighter_variant: informational only, never used for selection: 0 bp fee (Lighter standard account taker 0) + same slippage tiers, Binance funding as proxy. Lighter lists only a subset of these memes; depth unverified.

unit: coin-week leg = one coin's nonzero net weight in one week. Leg P&L (fraction of capital) = w*r_week - funding - costs attributed.

splits.train: rebalances t with t < 2025-07-01 (first tradable week = first Monday with >= 8 eligible memes)

bar: per split: n (coin-week legs) >= 50, net > 0, profit factor > 1.2, net without the 3 best coin-week legs > 0. Also reported: weekly portfolio Sharpe (x sqrt 52), number of independent (traded) weeks, per-year net, long/short leg split, funding, costs.
selection: Run all 12 on train. Select ONE: among configs passing the bar on train, the highest train net-ex-top-3; if none pass, the highest train net-ex-top-3 config is still run on validation once FOR INFORMATION and the hypothesis is a FAIL. Validation run exactly once on that config.
multiple_testing: 12 configs; a single train pass among 12 is weak evidence; validation is the test.
